build.reason: The recipe selects a static library and compiles the target, but the supplied packet lacks the complete CMake configuration needed to affirm the configured build.

input.reason: Input bytes and size are passed to XML_Parse, but the target asserts size <= INT_MAX and no supplied input-size bound resolves that assertion for every generated input.

lifecycle.reason: Created parsers are checked, child parsers are freed after use, and the parent is freed last; reset is limited to odd-sized inputs and rejects child reset without invalidating cleanup.

control_flow.reason: Every ParseOneInput invocation sets the legacy salt before parsing and never calls the new explicit 16-byte setter.

accepted.requirement: Exercise the supported pre-parse operation that sets an explicit 16-byte hash salt for the parsers this target creates and parses.
accepted.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates root and external parsers; each ParseOneInput calls XML_SetHashSalt before XML_Parse.
accepted.failure_condition: For any target input, the explicit setter is never called. The invoked legacy setter writes zero to the first 64-bit key half, so it cannot supply an explicit 16-byte key with a nonzero first half.
accepted.alternative_paths: Automatic generation may create a full-width key when the salt remains unset, but it does not exercise caller-supplied 16-byte entropy. Child parsers inherit the parent's salt and are passed through the same legacy setter; neither route is equivalent.

source_evidence.quote:
XML_Bool XMLCALL XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes(XML_Parser parser, const uint8_t entropy[16]);
Sets the hash salt to use for internal hash calculations. Helps in preventing DoS attacks based on predicting hash function behavior. In order to have an effect this must be called before parsing has started. Returns XML_TRUE if successful, XML_FALSE when called after XML_Parse or XML_ParseBuffer or when parser is NULL.
